functions.name: Unit_FindAbilityByClass
functions.comment: Payoff149 FORM-01.3: Move_BeginTargetTaskRequest calls this lookup with class Adro, derived=1, rawcode=0, ordinary=1, item=1. The general loop compares virtual+1c class identity, optionally AgentClass_IsDerived, rather than the authored alias at ability+34. Both ordinary and item attachments participate even if their commands are disabled. Engine aliases inherit a registry-owned target-no-warp trait; CargoDrop procedure reuse by Amed and Atdp does not imply Adro class ownership.

functions.name: Move_BeginTargetTaskRequest
functions.comment: Payoff149 FORM-01.3: capture target Adro-class ownership once when constructing the request; bit10 disables new group coarse warp edges. Existing requests do not re-read target abilities. A fresh persistent task after approach completion samples ownership again. Unit_FindAbilityByClass includes item attachments and derived class identities; comparing only rawcode or shared procedure is insufficient.

functions.name: PathGroup_RequestRoute
functions.comment: Payoff149 FORM-01.3: only a newly requested coarse route passes ~(group80>>4)&1 to167120. Cached adaptive routes bypass this call and retain their original policy. Engine passes captured group bit10 to G_UnitMoveGroupDestination; disabling warp edges does not remove or deactivate the published gate graph, and subsequent ordinary requests restore warp mode.
